whatThisPins: a refusal moves NEITHER floor NOR highestAccepted
the same refused frame replayed N times increments the counter N times
the bound walks forward only with ACCEPTANCE, never with a drop or a duplicate
a pairEpoch change rebuilds the record and re-arms the bound at the new floor

vectors.note: The frozen edge: exactly +WINDOW above a fresh highestAccepted is legitimate. frameBuffer resume can produce it; a receiver that refused here would break reconnect.
+WINDOW+1 is unreachable by any honest sender. Refused, and the floor does not move — that immobility IS the fix.
A5's own wording: 'the same frame twice -> refused twice, counter = 2'. A counter that deduped its own refusals would report a flood as a single event.
A refusal between two accepts must leave the window exactly as the accepts left it.
highestAccepted 2048 after a legitimate climb; the floor is only 257 because of the 256 cap. The bound is measured from ACCEPTANCE, so 3072 is still admissible and 3073 is not.

THE REGRESSION VECTOR. Pre-M-A5-2 each of these three far-future frames was ACCEPTED and walked the floor up by 256, so ~20k injections silenced the pairing. Now: refused, floor pinned at 0, and the next real frame still lands.

A new epoch is a new key and a new record. The bound must be re-armed from the new floor, not inherited from the old highestAccepted — inheriting it would refuse every legitimate frame after an Accept.
